description: Entry flow and authentication screens rebuild: SplashPage (white+blue), OnboardingPage (3 slides with full-bleed generic Unsplash amusement park images, white overlay), LoginPage (white background, 4 distinct states: choice/signin/signup/guest). Remove fake hardcoded Google/Facebook user objects from authStore — replace loginWithGoogle with real OAuth redirect, remove loginWithFacebook entirely. Remove initialNotifications fake data from authStore. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-001 (design token changes) — it must read the updated globals.css classes but all new classes used here are standard Tailwind utilities.
steps: 1. Read apps/web/src/pages/SplashPage.tsx in full. Rebuild: white background (bg-white), QueueCut logo mark as large blue circle/square (bg-blue-600) with white 'Q', brand name 'QueueCut' in navy (#0F172A) using font-display font-extrabold text-3xl, 'Cut' in blue-600. Tagline 'Know Before You Go' in slate-500. Blue pulse ring animation around logo. Background: bg-white with subtle blue radial gradient at top (from-blue-50/60). All navigation/timing logic preserved exactly (reads hasSeenOnboarding, calls setSplashSeen, navigates to /onboarding or /app/home).

2. Read apps/web/src/pages/OnboardingPage.tsx in full. Rebuild 3 slides: Slide 0 title='Discover Better Days' body='Find the right day to visit any park. Compare crowd levels, weather, and prices across dates.' image=https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516450360452-9312f5e86fc7?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80 . Slide 1 title='Avoid Long Queues' body='Plan around crowds and waiting times with real intelligence before you go.' image=https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1513889961551-628c1e5e2ee9?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80 . Slide 2 title='Plan Your Perfect Visit' body='Weather, timing, and pricing in one place.' image=https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583086074738-e46e9a19e526?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80 . Layout: full-bleed image fills top 60% of screen, white panel slides up from bottom 40% with heading+body text. Progress dots white/transparent on image. 'Skip' top-right in white. Final slide 'Get Started' blue solid button + 'Next' on intermediate. Navigation logic (setOnboardingSeen, navigate to /login) preserved exactly. Use AnimatePresence for slide transitions.

3. Read apps/web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx in full. Keep the 3-view state machine (choice/signin/signup). Add guest as integrated into choice screen (link below divider). Apply new aesthetic: white background, top blue gradient accent bar (h-2 bg-blue-600 at very top). Logo centered. Choice screen: Google button (white bg, shadow, Google SVG icon — keep real OAuth redirect logic: window.location.assign('/api/v1/auth/google/login')), 'Sign In with Email' button (blue outlined), 'Create Account' button (blue solid), divider, 'Continue as Guest' text link. Remove the Facebook button entirely (no backend support). Sign In form: white card, blue focus rings, real API wiring (apiClient.login) — keep existing. Sign Up form: white card, blue focus rings, real API wiring (apiClient.register) — keep existing. handleGuestBrowse unchanged. Error messages in red below inputs.

4. Read apps/web/src/store/slices/authStore.ts in full. Remove loginWithGoogle function body that creates a fake user — replace with: loginWithGoogle: () => { window.location.assign('/api/v1/auth/google/login'); }. Remove loginWithFacebook function and its type from AuthState interface. Remove initialNotifications array — set notifications: [] as initial value. Remove all references to loginWithFacebook in LoginPage.tsx. Keep ALL other authStore logic unchanged (loginWithEmail via real API, setAuthenticatedUser, continueAsGuest, logout, saveTrip, etc.).
acceptance_criteria: SplashPage renders white background with blue logo mark
OnboardingPage slides show Unsplash generic amusement park images (not park-specific claims)
LoginPage Google button calls window.location.assign('/api/v1/auth/google/login') not a fake user creator
authStore has no initialNotifications fake data array
